output.reason: Evidence establishes specific rules for loans sanctioned/renewed on or after 1 January 2026, including (a) floating rate loans not subject to pre-payment charges in certain cases (261(1) and 261(2)), (b) a general “approved policy” rule for other cases (261(5)), and (c) “no pre-payment charges” situations (261(6), 261(7)). However, the evidence does not explicitly state the decision criterion “if it is floating at the time of pre-payment.” It instead applies based on the loan type at the time it was granted (e.g., “floating rate loans granted…”). Therefore, the claim’s conditional framing (“floating at the time of pre-payment”) is not fully supported, though the general set of applicable floating-rate/no-charge/approved-policy directions for loans sanctioned/renewed on or after 1 January 2026 is supported.
